newsitem.title: UK: EMI bounces back, BZW says weakness overdone.
newsitem.headline: EMI bounces back, BZW says weakness overdone.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc recovered from recent losses on Wednesday, helped by positive comment from analysts at BZW, dealers said.

The shares were up 13-1/2p at 13.04 stg by 1110 GMT, in turnover of 1.4 million shares. Market sources said analysts at BZW met with music company EMI and felt that U.S. worries were short-term and there was no need to downgrade forecasts at this stage.
Concern over sales in the U.S. had been weighing on EMI's shares which ended their first day of trade in August at 14.60 stg. BZW reiterated its "buy' recommendation on the stock.
